blurb: The Flava Factory offers youth dance programs by age groups and skill levels, including foundational moves, freestyle, choreography, and crew programs with performance opportunities. Adult intro classes teach foundational street dance styles once a week. Drop-in classes are available for experienced dancers to learn choreography and styles intensively. They also offer workshops, performances, and studio rentals.
